item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya's mother makes a glass of nimbu pani (lemon water) by stirring lemon juice, sugar and salt into water until everything dissolves. Priya looks at the glass and cannot see the sugar, salt or lemon juice separately. How should Priya classify this mixture, and why?

options.A: Uniform mixture, because the components are spread evenly throughout and cannot be seen separately
options.B: Non-uniform mixture, because it contains more than one substance mixed together
options.C: Uniform mixture, because the lemon juice gives it one colour that can be seen
options.D: Non-uniform mixture, because the sugar is heavier than water and settles down
